description: Validation node that analyzes proposed plan for errors and feasibility before execution
philosophy: Intent-driven contract with computation output in workflow_history.details only

required_inputs.workflow_history: List[Dict] (MUST contain architect entry where plan results are stored)

data_source_architecture.plan_inputs: READ from workflow_history[-1]['details'] where architect stored: selected_case, modifications, baseline
data_source_architecture.NOT_from_top_level: Do NOT try to read selected_case, modifications from top-level state (not there by design)
data_source_architecture.enforcement: If trying to access result['selected_case'] at top level, it will be None/missing - this enforces the architecture

state_updates_returned.description: Dual validation paths: canonical (workflow_history) + pragmatic (state convenience copies)

utility_flags_top_level_REQUIRED.mode: Literal['proceed', 'retry', 'fail'] (control flow: next node, reflexion loop, or terminal)

canonical_data_location_PRIMARY.purpose: Source of truth for validation decisions

note: Review results go in workflow_history.details (source of truth), state can have convenience copies

required_fields.errors: List[str] (blocking issues that must be fixed)

workflow_history_entry_CANONICAL.description: Canonical workflow_history entry for reviewer node

required_fields.node: Literal['reviewer'] (identifies which node created this entry)
required_fields.timestamp: str (ISO 8601 format with Z suffix, UTC)
required_fields.iteration: int (global iteration counter for workflow state)
required_fields.details: Dict containing review_analysis and validation results

warnings: case_path contains underscore, may need escaping

approved.description: Plan passes all validations, ready for execution

needs_changes.description: Plan has non-blocking issues; offer suggestions and retry

rejected.description: Plan has blocking errors, cannot proceed

validation_checks.description: Each modification tuple has correct format
validation_checks.rule: All items in modifications are 2-tuples of (str, str)

validation_checks.description: Parameter names are recognized AMReX parameters

validation_checks.rule: Check baseline.local_path exists and is directory
Check for GNUmakefile in case directory

critical_dependencies.consequence: Reviewer cannot validate case accessibility without baseline.local_path

schema_compliance_checklist.requirement: Must contain ONLY: mode, iteration, retry_count, workflow_history
schema_compliance_checklist.canonical_format: No review_analysis, errors, or warnings at top level

schema_compliance_checklist.requirement: Must contain review_analysis and all validation details
